props.author: swarmister
props.text: That said, overall, since the beginning of summer, $ETH has been outperforming BTC and has been rising against it after testing a mirror level. And that concerns me.
This aligns with the established 3-trader bearish lean (HCH/ryzzqq/Chase) on ETH; structure shows recent recovery testing mirror support, but long-term downtrend remains intact per daily confluence.
